verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated pricing-and-limits doc page. It says Model APIs enforce request and token rate limits, documents rate-limit response headers (x-ratelimit-remaining-requests), and names usage tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise), noting that Basic limits can be raised via email verification or a tier upgrade. However, the evidence shows no actual per-tier limit values or how limits scale between tiers. Missing for 10: concrete numeric request/token limits per tier, an explicit description of how limits scale from Basic to Pro to Enterprise, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production

citations.quote: Model APIs bill by token and enforce request and token rate limits.
x-ratelimit-remaining-requests: Reports how many requests remain before you reach the request rate limit.
To raise a Basic account's limits, request email verification. You can also use that form to move to Pro or Enterprise.
